Row 5 Item cell prints two quantities on one printed line: 'Gas yield, m³/kg of VS added in m³/capita/d'. Retained as one cell string; the two quantities are not split and no value is supplied for the second.
Row 6 prints only a unit, 'm³/capita/d', as the Item, with magnitude 0.034. Retained as printed.
The superscript 3 in every printed unit (m³) is recorded as ³; the printed exponent is not flattened to m3.
Row 1 prints 'Volumetric Organic loading' with a capital O; retained as printed, not corrected.
Numeric ranges (25-30, 45-55) are printed with a hyphen and are retained as one string.
